name: Clomethiazole
summary: A strong sedative and sleep medicine, used mainly in Europe for short-term treatment of severe insomnia in older adults and for agitation during alcohol withdrawal.
description: Clomethiazole is a thiazole medicine with strong sedative and sleep-inducing effects. It works on GABA-A receptors, the brain's main calming system, much like barbiturates and benzodiazepines, but it has a different chemical structure. It is used mainly in Europe for short-term treatment of severe insomnia in older adults and for controlling agitation during alcohol withdrawal. Because it can cause dependence and slow or stop breathing (respiratory depression), it is usually limited to hospital or closely supervised use.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Clomethiazole is a thiazole derivative with potent sedative and hypnotic effects. It acts as a GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator, similar to barbiturates and benzodiazepines, but with a distinct chemical structure. It is primarily used in Europe for short-term treatment of severe insomnia in the elderly and for controlling agitation in acute alcohol withdrawal. Due to its dependence potential and risk of respiratory depression, it is usually restricted to inpatient or closely supervised use.
